phase1_leaf_result.part104_scope: Official GitHub documentation audit of content-addressed commit objects, ordinary refs/releases, and immutable releases as rollback-independent monotonic witnesses.
phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: A commit SHA that is still readable after history rewrite is not a documented permanent monotonic witness; GitHub documents both residual SHA accessibility and later removal of residual cached/reference visibility.
phase1_leaf_result.strongest_candidate: Immutable releases lock tags/assets and protect against repository-name resurrection, but require repository/org Settings enablement and this leaf found no documented atomic coupling to an arbitrary separate authoritative effect sink.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: A default GitHub service-side monotonic incarnation marker needing no feature enablement or protected/admin/manual setup and capable of participating in, or reducing to, an atomic repository-local authority publication.

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Only the four official GitHub documentation surfaces recorded in Part104; no generalization to unaudited GitHub objects or already-enabled immutable-release environments.

continuation: Part105: execute one bounded public-source leaf on default GitHub service-side IDs/tombstones that need no repository/org feature enablement. Audit issue/comment/release/repository IDs for non-reuse, deletion persistence, discoverability and write/read permissions; test whether any supplies a monotonic incarnation marker that can be coupled to repository-local CAS publication without a separate settings/protected/manual step. Reject finite-retention, deletable, undiscoverable, non-monotonic or separately committed markers and persist the next alternative witness class if none pass.
